title: Interested in some feedback
author: AleksZakharov
selftext:
I'm a big fan of cozy games. I'm not dev and got some basic skills in VFX with Blender (but that's the case here).

My main job unrelated to gamedev, but I want to create game, which I can enjoy.

So, I decide to try some prompting and made this prototype. Now I want to hear some feedback: is it overall interesting, engaging, etc.

I want to change visuals later, build much more mechanics, play with balance.

Game using realtime season, time of the day and even weather info based on user location (or VPN location). You can see different tweaks in developer menu and mess up with them.

Video - [https://youtu.be/qBhKZkUurCY](https://youtu.be/qBhKZkUurCY)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/AleksZakharov please update this post with more on how you used AI to build the game. A line saying it was made with AI isn't enough. Share dev details. Rule 4 is there so promotional posts add to the sub by talking about the process and real development. We don't want the sub drowned in empty promotion. Posts that aren't updated may be removed.

replies.author: AleksZakharov
replies.body: Sorry, it's not really promoting, but interesting in feedback and criticism. Post updated, hope it's not breaking rule right now
